positive.prompt: Viết Tech-Spec đặc tả kỹ thuật dựa trên Business-Spec trước khi code
Thiết kế kỹ thuật Architecture Decision API Contract Data Model Error Handling
Bắt đầu implement feature mới cần viết Tech-Spec thiết kế kỹ thuật

negative.prompt: Triển khai code theo từng bước tăng dần

evals.prompt: Viết Tech-Spec cho Order Management feature dựa trên Business-Spec đã có
evals.expected_output: Complete Tech-Spec with architecture, API contract, data model, business logic, error handling, and testing strategy
expectations: Tech-Spec reads Business-Spec from correct path
Architecture Decision aligns with existing project stack
API Contract includes detailed endpoints with request/response examples
Data Model has complete SQL DDL with indexes and constraints
Business Logic covers all Business Rules from Business-Spec
Error Handling includes retry logic, circuit breaker, idempotency
Testing Strategy has unit/integration/load test plans
Non-Functional Requirements are quantified (numbers, not adjectives)
Output file is generated at workspace/{issueKey}/tech/tech-spec.md

evals.prompt: Review Tech-Spec and check if it covers all Business Rules from Business-Spec
evals.expected_output: Traceability matrix showing Business Rule → Tech-Spec section mapping, with gaps highlighted
expectations: Agent reads both Business-Spec and Tech-Spec
Creates mapping between Business Rules and Tech-Spec sections
Identifies missing Business Rules not covered in Tech-Spec
